reason: The README describes a plugin that selects and injects global, project, and creative-mode rules into minimal-mode conversations while providing a mode selector and local mode persistence, so its primary purpose is managing agent context.

summaries.zh: 一个为 DSH 极简模式选择并注入全局、项目及创造模式规则的上下文管理插件。
summaries.en: A context-management plugin for selecting and injecting global, project, and creative-mode rules into DSH minimal-mode conversations.

capabilities: Reads global and project AGENTS.md files
Injects selected rule content into minimal-mode conversations
Adds a mode selector to the input interface
Persists the selected mode in a local configuration file
